scientific_limitations: Single work-conserving server and finite clusters with strictly positive work; at subcritical load for the Poisson law.
Busy and idle intervals, not individual workloads or sojourn times, agree under the service-cover condition.
The necessary and sufficient deterministic characterization is uniform over primary schedules; an individual schedule may conceal a service-cover violation.
A 2003 periodic equal-service clustered cell model already exhibits a particular busy-equivalence property; independent historical-priority review remains open.
Finite exact and numerical checks supplement but do not replace the analytic proof.
title: Sharp service-cover criterion and exact busy cycles for triggered-cluster queues
